description: As long as you hold a melee weapon in one hand and don't use another weapon, you get a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.
If the creature you see is not attacking you, but another creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to interfere with its attack roll.
As long as you wear the armor, you get a +1 CD bonus.

If you have a "1" or "2" on the damage dice during an attack that you made with a melee weapon, holding it with both hands, then you can throw this die, and you must use the new result, even if "1" or "2" is dropped again.
You get a +2 bonus to the attack roll when you attack with a ranged weapon.
